fields.v: Partly (0.5): main-text claims tied to significant results and resolution unchanged on Opus noted; but under the OpenHands harness (Table 6) CoReMem w/o training and post-trained CoReMem take more steps (38.6 and 45.9 vs 33.8) and more tokens (1240K and 1647K vs 897K) than no memory, which App. E does not mention while reporting only resolution and resolve per token as generalisation evidence
fields.where: Table 6, App. E Results Beyond the Training Distribution, p. 18
fields.why: The OpenHands check contradicts the paper's central effort-saving claim (more steps and tokens than no memory), and the text reports only the favourable resolution figures, which may warrant Partly rather than Yes.
fields.doubt: Na Tabela 6 (pág. 18, OpenHands) o CoReMem gasta mais passos e tokens do que 'sem memória' (38,6 e 45,9 vs 33,8 passos; 1240K e 1647K vs 897K). O texto do Apêndice E (pág. 17) só refere a subida da resolução. Decide se Q9 passa de Sim para Parcial.
